publication.title: Census of currently known specimens of the Late Jurassic sauropod Haplocanthosaurus from the Morrison Formation, USA
authors: B. Curtice, D. R. Wilhite, M. J. Wedel

locality.name: PBDB collection 28366: 11 km N of Cañon City, Colorado. NE 1/4 of SE 1/4 of sec. 28, T17S, R70W. S end of Garden Park. Site above a cliff on N side of arroyo feeding into Four Mile (= Oil) Creek (main drainage for Garden Park).

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 28366 to Late Kimmeridgian–Early Tithonian with numeric bounds 152.21–145.06 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 90754; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 1685357 records Diplodocoidea in collection 28366, linked by PBDB to reference 90754.
